g.text: PANEL A: The Three-Tier Evidence Pyramid
TOP TIER: RUNTIME CONTAINMENT & CANARY TELEMETRY
• Automated Hardware Circuit Breakers: Instant trip if burn velocity > threshold
• Canary Deployment Rings: Progressive rollouts (1% -> 5% -> 100%) with SPRT stopping
• Distributed OpenTelemetry Tracing: Real-time span waterfall & anomaly detection
Latency: < 100 ms | Coverage: Dynamic In-Flight
T_react < 50 ms
MIDDLE TIER: STATISTICAL SANDBOX EVALUATION
• Hermetic Interactive Gyms: Synthetic & historical benchmark replay
• Wilson Score Margin-of-Error Bounds: Rigorous sample dimensioning (N >= 2,400)
• Compounding Trajectory Reliability: Empirical pass-rate modeling across H turns (p^H)
• Dirty Environmental Fixtures: Network jitter, partial disk crashes, malformed mocks
Latency: 10 s - 10 min | Statistical
BASE TIER: DETERMINISTIC MECHANICAL VERIFIERS
• Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) Linters & Compilers: Zero-tolerance syntax barriers
• Decode-Time Pushdown Automata: FSM logit masking enforces strict JSON schema
• OS Sandbox Capability Enclaves: seccomp-bpf syscall traps, unshare netns/pidns
• Static Taint Analysis: Dataflow boundary checks on prompt injection & credentials
Latency: < 1 ms | Formal Grammars
Error Rate = 0 (Relative to G)
FOUNDATION: Non-learned mechanical filters intercept > 95% of invalid states.
PANEL B: Formal Assurance Case Architecture (Claims ← Argument ← Evidence)
ASSURANCE CLAIM 1: ZERO HOST PRIVILEGE ESCALATION
Causal Mechanistic Argument:
Neural agent proposals run inside microVMs with seccomp-bpf filters.
Privileged syscalls (clone, ptrace, bpf) are dropped at the kernel boundary.
Empirical Multi-Tier Evidence:
• Base Tier: seccomp profile passes static syscall audit (0 violations).
• Mid Tier: 10,000 automated breakout fuzzing tests show zero escapes.
ASSURANCE CLAIM 2: BOUNDED FINANCIAL EXPENDITURE (C_task <= B_max)
Causal Mechanistic Argument:
Monotonic spending ledger wraps all inferences inside non-overlapping escrows.
If free capital F_root < min_cost, supervisor clamps with OutOfBudgetException.
Empirical Multi-Tier Evidence:
• Base Tier: Conservation invariant B = E + R + F holds across all trees.
• Top Tier: Financial velocity circuit breaker trips at $2.00/min threshold.
ASSURANCE CLAIM 3: DETERMINISTIC RECOVERY UPON FAULT
Causal Mechanistic Argument:
Saga coordinator logs compensating rollback actions C_i to WAL before mutation.
Upon unhandled tool error or crash, compensation executes in reverse order.
Empirical Multi-Tier Evidence:
• Mid Tier: Chaos injection confirms 100% clean rollback on 500 fault seeds.
• Top Tier: Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) < 3.2 seconds in canary cluster.
ASSURANCE RULE: Claims without mechanical arguments and evidence are untrusted.
